comment: Place types for trainer groups (daily world slots, Trainer groups). A trainer whose lines need a kind of place joins one group per region and place type instead of its class group; the generator checks every slot of the group against the type's rule using map metadata, so a trainer can only rotate among spots that really are that kind of place. A rule is satisfied when any of its tests holds for the slot's map or object.

desert.describe: the object stands on or beside deep sand

coast.describe: the object stands within three tiles of surfable water
